questions.question: Solve the system: 2x + 3y = 7 and 5x - 2y = 8
questions.explanation: Elimination: multiply first by 2 and second by 3: 4x + 6y = 14 and 15x - 6y = 24. Add: 19x = 38 ⇒ x = 2. Substitute: 2(2) + 3y = 7 ⇒ 3y = 3 ⇒ y = 1.
questions.fastStrategy: Elimination method: multiply to align coefficients.

questions.question: A system of 3 equations in 3 unknowns has the augmented matrix [1 2 3 | 9; 2 -1 1 | 8; 3 1 4 | 17]. Is this system consistent?
questions.explanation: Check if rows are independent. The coefficient matrix has 3 equations and 3 unknowns. If determinant ≠ 0, unique solution. Quick check: no obvious dependency between rows.
